definitions.short: a jail (as a guard-house); also an aim (as being closely watched)
definitions.full: H4307. mattara or mattarah מַטָּרָה and ( Lam 3:12 ) מַטָּרָא noun feminine 1. guard, ward, prison Neh 3:25 . 2 target, mark (as kept in the eye, watched , compare נָצַר Prov 23:26 , and σκόπος ( watcher, mark ) from σκέπτομαι ; perhaps Nabataean [ רתא ] מט Lzb 323 ); — always absolute: — 1 guard, ward, prison , usually הַמּ ׳חֲצַר court of gaurd (see I. ׳חָצֵ ) Jer 32:2 , 8 , 12 ; 33:1 ; 37:21 (twice in verse); 38:6 , 13 , 28 ; 39:14-15 , הַמּ ׳שַׁעַר Neh 12:39 . 2 target, mark Job 16:12 (figurative of ׳י s chastisement), לַחֵץ כַּמַּטָּרָא Lam 3:12 (simile id. ); literally only 1Sam 20:20 .
